data.one_liner: Xml digital signature library for Dart for signing and verifying XML documents.
data.what_it_does: Allows you to sign XML documents and verify XML digital signatures using various canonicalization, transformation, hashing, and signature algorithms including RSA and ECDSA.
use_when: You need to create XML digital signatures for SOAP or other XML-based web services.
You need to verify signed XML documents received from external clients or services.
avoid_when: You are working with JSON data instead of XML.
You do not require cryptographic XML signatures.
strengths: Supports multiple signature, hashing, and canonicalization algorithms (RSA, ECDSA, SHA, C14N).
Port of the established Node.js xml-crypto library.
weaknesses: XML digital signature specifications can be complex and prone to subtle verification errors (implicit transforms, etc.).
HMAC-SHA1 is disabled by default due to key confusion risks.
